Gyu Shige – the long-standing Yakiniku restaurant chain has received a lot of favors from Japanese customers, with over 160 stores along across the famous cities of Asia.

 

Carrying the quintessence from Japanese cuisine to Vietnam under the name of Gyu Shige, the restaurant uses the superior kinds of beef and seafood with the fresh ingredient sources imported from selective locals, also the vegetables are directly planted at the restaurant’s farm in Da Lat with the purpose of bringing the experience of Yakiniku’s pure taste closer to Vietnamese gourmets.
